title: In Silico Drug Design of Anti-Breast Cancer Agents.
authors: Rajagopal, Kalirajan; Kalusalingam, Anandarajagopal; Bharathidasan, Anubhav Raj; Sivaprakash, Aadarsh; Shanmugam, Krutheesh; Sundaramoorthy, Monall; Byran, Gowramma
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接和MM-GB/SA研究小分子药物与雌激素受体α的结合，属于蛋白-配体互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或MD模拟方法，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制研究无关。
abstract: Cancer is a condition marked by abnormal cell proliferation that has the potential to invade or indicate other health issues. Human beings are affected by more than 100 different types of cancer. Some cancer promotes rapid cell proliferation, whereas others cause cells to divide and develop more slowly. Some cancers, such as leukemia, produce visible tumors, while others, such as breast cancer, do not. In this work, in silico investigations were carried out to investigate the binding mechanisms of four major analogs, which are marine sesquiterpene, sesquiterpene lactone, heteroaromatic chalcones, and benzothiophene against the target estrogen receptor-alpha for targeting breast cancer using Schrodinger suite 2021-4. The Glide module handled the molecular docking experiments, the QikProp module handled the ADMET screening, and the Prime MM-GB/SA module determined the binding energy of the ligands. The benzothiophene analog BT_ER_15f (G-score -15.922 Kcal/mol) showed the best binding activity against the target protein estrogen receptor-alpha when compared with the standard drug tamoxifen which has a docking score of -13.560 Kcal/mol. TRP383 (tryptophan) has the highest interaction time with the ligand, and hence it could act for a long time. Based on in silico investigations, the benzothiophene analog BT_ER_15f significantly binds with the active site of the target protein estrogen receptor-alpha. Similar to the outcomes of molecular docking, the target and ligand complex interaction motif established a high affinity of lead candidates in a dynamic system. This study shows that estrogen receptor-alpha targets inhibitors with better potential and low toxicity when compared to the existing market drugs, which can be made from a benzothiophene derivative. It may result in considerable activity and be applied to more research on breast cancer.
abstract_zh: 癌症是一种以异常细胞增殖为特征的疾病，可能具有侵袭性或提示其他健康问题。人类受超过100种不同类型的癌症影响。有些癌症促进细胞快速增殖，而另一些则导致细胞分裂和发育较为缓慢。某些癌症，如白血病，会产生可见肿瘤，而其他类型，如乳腺癌，则不会。在本研究中，进行了计算机模拟 (in silico) 研究，以探讨四种主要类似物——海洋倍半萜 (marine sesquiterpene)、倍半萜内酯 (sesquiterpene lactone)、杂芳基查尔酮 (heteroaromatic chalcones) 和苯并噻吩 (benzothiophene)——针对靶标雌激素受体-α (estrogen receptor-alpha) 的结合机制，以靶向乳腺癌，使用Schrodinger套件2021-4。Glide模块处理了分子对接实验，QikProp模块处理了ADMET筛选，Prime MM-GB/SA模块确定了配体的结合能。苯并噻吩类似物BT_ER_15f（G-score -15.922 Kcal/mol）在与标准药物他莫昔芬（对接分数为-13.560 Kcal/mol）相比时，显示出对靶蛋白雌激素受体-α的最佳结合活性。TRP383（色氨酸）与配体的相互作用时间最长，因此可能持续作用较长时间。基于计算机模拟研究，苯并噻吩类似物BT_ER_15f显著结合于靶蛋白雌激素受体-α的活性位点。与分子对接结果类似，靶标和配体复合物的相互作用模式在动态系统中确立了先导候选物的高亲和力。本研究表明，与现有市场药物相比，雌激素受体-α靶向抑制剂具有更好的潜力和较低的毒性，可由苯并噻吩衍生物制成。这可能产生显著活性，并应用于更多乳腺癌研究。
